verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Sequential verification found that the extended-real convex dichotomy, tail monotonicity, sheaf gluing, endpoint-trace preservation under decreasing limits, and the generated-sheaf inclusion are valid. The convex Lipschitz extension, heat-semigroup monotonicity, exact regularized-maximum clamp, composition Hessian calculation, endpoint convergence, and finite-trace uniform estimate rigorously produce decreasing stage-zero approximants on one fixed endpoint neighborhood. The interior supporting-line extension completes the local first-stage inclusion, and u(t)=t is correctly covered when its endpoint value is -infinity. The mandated theorem-index searches returned no exact CLD25 matches, so the citations were checked against the [primary July 2025 arXiv v2 PDF/source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1204.6277v2): Example 6.7.2, Sections 6.1.1 and 6.1.6, Definition 6.2.1, Definition 8.1.1, and Lemma 8.1.4 all match the proof's uses and terminology. No critical error or gap was found.
